info.name: Dentist Booking - Team Presentation
info.description: Seed the demo database before each full run. Run the Core folders, pause for Class/Sequence slides, then run the Extra folders. Setup checks readiness and roles. Credentials come from the local environment. The queue/waiting-list demo cancels a booking; reset before repeating.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Checks auth, database readiness and route role guards after the A+B integration. Admin access must return 200. Use admin-core and queue-waitlist collections to verify all B features.

exec: const plus = n => { const d = new Date(today + 'T12:00:00Z'); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n); return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };
pm.test('Registered user and telephone', () => { const u=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(u.role).to.equal('user'); pm.expect(u.tel).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: P0 Admin role guard - feature demo is separate

exec: pm.test('Admin passes the role guard', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: P0 Logout and clear client token
P0 Anonymous request denied after logout
01-08 User Core
item.description: Core requirements 1-6 in presentation order. Creates a fresh user each run, enforces one booking and cancels it before logout. Credentials come from the local environment.

exec: pm.test('Dentist information is available', () => { pm.expect(data.length).to.be.above(0); data.forEach(d => { pm.expect(d.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.yearsOfExperience).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.expertise).to.be.a('string'); }); });
if (data && data.length) { pm.environment.set('dentistId', data[0]._id); pm.environment.set('secondDentistId', (data[1] || data[0])._id); }

pm.test('Booking belongs to the registered user', () => { pm.expect(data.user._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('userId')); pm.expect(data.dentist._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('dentistId')); pm.expect(data.bookingDate).to.equal(pm.environment.get('bookingDate')); });
pm.test('Exactly one own booking', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.count).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.data[0]._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('appointmentId')); });

pm.test('Own booking reference', () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.bookingReference).to.equal(pm.environment.get('appointmentId')); pm.expect(data.user._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('userId')); });

item.name: 07 Repeated cancellation keeps the same timestamp
08 Access without client token is denied
09-12 Admin Core
item.description: B: admin views, edits and cancels any booking. Run after a fresh seed:demo.

pm.test('Token returned at top level', () => pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a('string'));
pm.test('Token returned at top level', () => pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a('string'));

item.name: 09 Normal user cannot view all bookings

exec: pm.test('Only booked appointments by default', () => body.data.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.status).to.equal('booked')));
pm.test('Includes bookings of other users', () => pm.expect(body.data.map((row) => row._id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('adminAppointmentId')));
pm.test('Every row matches the dentist', () => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.above(0); rows.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.dentist._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('secondDentistId'))); });

item.name: 12 Repeat cancellation keeps the first time
12 Cancelled booking leaves the current list
15 Extra - Questionnaire and QR
item.description: Additional requirements #1 and #4. Uses the separate extra booking. Does not cancel it so the queue/waiting-list demo can run afterwards. Newman exports a PNG from this run after all assertions pass.

exec: pm.test('Responses are linked to the booking', () => { const answer = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(answer.appointment).to.equal(pm.environment.get('extraAppointmentId')); pm.expect(answer.reasonForVisit).to.equal('Tooth pain'); });

pm.test('Owner sees saved answers', () => { const answer = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(answer.reasonForVisit).to.equal('Tooth pain'); pm.expect(answer.allergyInfo).to.equal('No known allergies'); pm.expect(answer.notes).to.equal('Demo responses only'); });

pm.test('Admin sees the correct booking responses', () => { const answer = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(answer.appointment).to.equal(pm.environment.get('extraAppointmentId')); pm.expect(answer.reasonForVisit).to.equal('Tooth pain'); });

item.name: Extra 1 - another user cannot read responses
Extra 1 - another user cannot change responses
Extra 1 - admin cannot change owner responses
Extra 4 - owner views booking with generated QR

exec: pm.test('QR PNG is returned for this booking', () => { pm.expect(booking.bookingReference).to.equal(pm.environment.get('extraAppointmentId')); pm.expect(booking.qrCodeDataUrl).to.match(/^data:image\/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo/); });

item.name: Extra 4 - repeated view keeps the booking reference

exec: pm.test('Reference and QR remain stable', () => { const booking = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(booking.bookingReference).to.equal(pm.environment.get('bookingQrReference')); pm.expect(booking.qrCodeDataUrl).to.equal(pm.environment.get('bookingQrDataUrl')); });

item.name: W1 Waiting user A cannot join twice

exec: pm.test('Token returned at top level', () => pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a('string'));

item.name: W2 User sees only their own entries

exec: pm.test('Only waiter A entries', () => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.equal(1); rows.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.user).to.equal(pm.environment.get('waiterAId'))); });

item.name: W2 Admin must choose dentist and date
W3 Cancelled booking leaves the arrival queue

exec: pm.test('Only the remaining booking is queued', () => { const rows = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(rows.length).to.equal(1); pm.expect(rows[0].appointment).to.equal(pm.environment.get('queueAppointmentId')); });

item.name: W3 Admin view waiting registration order

exec: pm.test('Two waiters in registration order', () => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.equal(2); pm.expect(rows[0]._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('waitlistEntryId')); pm.expect(rows[1]._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('waitlistEntryBId')); });

item.name: W4 Another user cannot remove the entry

exec: pm.test('One waiter remains', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.count).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.data[0]._id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('waitlistEntryBId')); });

item.name: W5 Rejoined user goes to the end

exec: pm.test('Waiter B first, waiter A last', () => { const rows = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(rows.map((row) => row._id)).to.deep.equal([pm.environment.get('waitlistEntryBId'), pm.environment.get('waitlistEntryId')]); });
